text:
The topology is right; only CMRR fails, short by about 5 dB. The tail device M5 sits on the saturation edge (0.074 V margin, gm/gds = 46). Raising the PMOS mirror gm/Id gives the most CMRR per step. Raising tail-source gm/Id and pair gm/Id lowers Vdsat and Vgs, which frees tail headroom. Together these should close the gap without hurting the other specs. One thing to fix in the program later: its PSRR model is badly off (67 dB predicted vs 99 dB simulated).
